io.name: areset
io.description: Asynchronous positive-edge reset; resets Lemming to walk_left.

io.name: bump_left
io.description: Bump on left side; causes direction switch to walk right when walking.

io.name: bump_right
io.description: Bump on right side; causes direction switch to walk left when walking.

io.name: dig
io.description: Command to dig when walking on ground.

functional_summary.overview: Moore FSM modeling a Lemming that walks left/right, switches direction on bumps, falls when ground=0, digs when instructed while walking on ground, and splatters after falling more than 20 cycles then landing. Reset asynchronously to walk_left.
rules: Reset: areset high asynchronously forces state to WALK_LEFT with outputs walk_left=1, others 0.
Walking: in WALK_LEFT or WALK_RIGHT with ground=1, if dig=1 begin digging; else if bumped (bump_left and/or bump_right) switch direction; else continue same direction.
Bump semantics: bump_left causes walk right; bump_right causes walk left; simultaneous bumps still switch direction.
Falling: if ground=0 while walking or digging, enter falling (aaah=1) and increment fall counter each cycle; direction is remembered.
During fall: bumps and dig are ignored; fall counter increments each cycle while ground=0.
Landing: when ground=1 while falling, if fall duration > 20 cycles splatter (all outputs 0 forever); else resume walking in remembered direction.
Digging: entered from walking on ground when dig=1; digging continues while ground=1; when ground=0, transition to falling (aaah=1) with remembered direction.
Splatter: after splattering, all outputs remain 0 until reset.
Outputs are Moore-type, determined by current state.
